task_title: LRU Cache Implementation with Eviction Return
prompt: Implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache class `LRUCache(capacity: int)` in Python with O(1) average-time `get(key)` and `put(key, value)` operations. `get` returns -1 if key does not exist. `put` inserts or updates the key; if inserting a new key causes capacity to be exceeded, evict the least recently used item AND return the evicted key. If no eviction occurred, `put` must return None.
